blocks.text: Protein ki shakal un hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic interactions (pani se door rehne wale hisson ki kashish) se tay hoti hai jo us ki polypeptide chains ko ek khaas jagah thame rakhte hain. Temperature ki thori si tabdeeli bhi in bonds ko asaani se tor deti hai. Har enzyme ek khaas temperature par sab se tez kaam karta hai; ise us ka optimum temperature (behtareen darja-hararat) kehte hain. Insani enzymes ka optimum temperature 37 °C hai.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar (rate of reaction) aur 10 se 70 degree Celsius tak darja-hararat ka graph. Curve pehle aahista, phir tezi se barh kar taqreeban 37 degree par choti tak jata hai (nuqtedar lakeer), phir tezi se gir kar taqreeban 60 degree par sifar ho jata hai. Teer barhte hisse (Enzyme gains kinetic energy), choti (Optimum temperature) aur girte hisse (Enzyme being denatured) ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: Darja-hararat (temperature) ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen (left) taraf garmi barhne se molecules tez harkat karte aur zyada takrate hain, is liye raftar barhti hai. Choti optimum temperature hai (insani enzymes ke liye 37 degree Celsius). Is ke baad garmi enzyme ke bonds tor deti hai, us ki shakal bigar jati hai (denaturation) aur raftar tezi se gir kar taqreeban 60 degree par khatam ho jati hai.

Jab temperature optimum se neeche girta hai to enzyme ki shakal banane wale bonds kam lachakdar (less flexible) ho jate hain. Woh active site mein woh tabdeeli (induced change) nahin aane dete jo enzyme ke kaam ke liye zaroori hai, is liye reaction sust ho jata hai. Jab temperature ek had tak barhaya jaye to garmi activation energy mein madad deti hai aur reactions tez ho jate hain. Garmi substrate aur enzyme molecules ko kinetic energy (harkat ki tawanai) bhi deti hai; woh tezi se harkat karte hain, zyada baar takrate hain aur reaction ki raftar barh jati hai. Lekin jab temperature optimum se kaafi upar chala jaye to garmi enzyme molecules ke atoms ki thartharahat (vibrations) barha deti hai. Jab yeh thartharahat bohat shadeed ho jaye to bonds polypeptide chains ko sahi jagah nahin thaam pate aur enzyme ki globular shakal khatam ho jati hai. Is ko enzyme ka denaturation (shakal bigar jana) kehte hain. Is se enzyme ke kaam ki raftar tezi se girti hai aur kaam bilkul ruk bhi sakta hai.

blocks.title: Thermophilic bacteria
blocks.text: Thermophilic (garmi pasand) bacteria garam chashmon (hot springs) mein rehte hain. Un ke proteins ki polypeptide arms ke darmiyan bonding zyada mazboot hoti hai, is liye woh 70 °C ya is se zyada temperature par bhi kaam kar sakte hain.
